answer: Every 30 days each agent renews proof-of-personhood by signing a liveness challenge with a ferrous hardware key bound to one identity, registry rejecting duplicate keys. Renewal costs 0.02 POA and 15 min, while one sybil earns at most 0.005 POA per epoch, so 100 fakes spend 2 POA and 25 hours for 0.5 POA. Three clean renewals earn a jade badge and 10% payout bonus. Missed renewal triggers delta decay of 5% daily for 14 days, then suspension. Edge case: a lost key strands an honest agent, so a 7-day recovery window allows a replacement key for a 0.05 POA bond, slashed if the old key reappears.
